doors.note: React shell: an empty mount, site-level JSON-LD (WebSite) and one hashed module script. No event text in the HTML.

The app bundle. The whole event list is written into it as object literals {id,title,venue,date,time,price,about,image,ticketLink,region}; region codes map to printed labels (PT = Provincetown Bear Week, FIBW = Fire Island Bear Weekend, DA = Dore Alley, FL = Folsom Street Fair). Dates print without a year. The hash in the file name changes with every deploy; the scraper finds it from the shell each run.
The only event-shaped endpoint the bundle names. Answers 500 "REST API fetch failed: 403" — their upstream refuses them. Not retried.

recon.notes: Recon from one cached read of the shell and one of the bundle on 2026-09-20. 201 objects: 8 live repeats, 39 upcoming singles, 154 past singles (the bear weeks of the summer), 0 repeats with nothing in the window.

coverage.basis: Feed door: every event object literal in the bundle was read. Repeats are ONE entry each with their nights in the window; dated objects on or after 2026-09-20 are singles; 154 earlier ones are counted as past listings. City is stated only by the row's group (Provincetown Bear Week, Folsom Street Fair, Dore Alley, Fire Island Bear Weekend); ungrouped rows belong to the one menu entry no group code names (NYC).

events.title: REAL BAD XXXVII
events.description: The Sunday night closer and the weekend's hardest ticket. Thousands pack 1015 Folsom across the main floor, the balcony and Red Room, the upstairs lounge, and the basement Underground, which runs its own DJ and its own sound. Produced by the nonprofit Grass Roots Gay Rights Foundation; general admission money goes straight to beneficiaries. Peak moments include the midnight popsicle run and the leather flag drop. Most tickets go out through a host network rather than a public sale, so start asking around early.

Enter from a side street like Harrison to get in faster. Bring sunblock and a refillable bottle; single-use water bottles can't be sold at the fair.
